name: soundbridge/timeline
title: History Timeline
description: An editable history timeline for milestones.

default.title: Founded
default.body: SoundBridge is established with a mission to make music accessible to every student in the Saginaw Bay community.

default.title: Community Roots Deepen
default.body: Partnerships with local schools and community centers expand the reach of SoundBridge programs across the region.

default.title: The Violin Club Launches
default.body: Our signature ongoing ensemble program opens its doors and quickly becomes a community favorite.

default.title: Summer Workshops Begin
default.body: The first summer intensive brings professional coaching to young musicians.

default.title: 5th Annual Chamber Music Camp
default.body: The expanded SoundBridge Chamber Music Camp enters its fifth year with growing enrollment and faculty.
